formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (14 : ℕ) x1 → (∃ (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x1 x4).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x1 x5).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (14 : ℕ) x1 x4 x5) → (∀ (x5 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x5) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x6 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x6, ↑x7) ∈ [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))] ∧ x5 x6 = Bool.true ∧ x5 x7 = Bool.true) → (27 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Every circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, each reading only earlier wires, with some AND gate inside the cone of another AND gate, that is true on 14 inputs exactly when both ends of some edge of the Heawood graph (points 0..6, lines 7..13, point p joined to line 7 + l when p + l mod 7 is 0, 1 or 3) are true, has at least 27 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph has at least 27 gates
